title: exp201_202_entities_test TC-EXP-202-01/02/03: createRecord's getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance schema-qualifies by tenant_id, but LEGACY_RLS-style tests never provision that physical schema
symptom: Re-measured in true isolation via `zig build test-integration-exp201-202` (new narrow step added this pass): TC-EXP-202-01/02/03 (create/update/delete record) all fail identically with PostgreSQL C42P01 'relation "tenant_<hex>.entity_type_instances" does not exist', captured via `-Dlog-pg-errors=true`. Root cause: src/entities/commands.zig's getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance() (line ~424) explicitly schema-qualifies its INSERT as `{s}.entity_type_instances` using schemaNameForTenant(tenant_id) -- correct when the caller's tenant actually has a provisioned physical schema (storage_mode='SCHEMA'). But tests/integration/exp201_202_entities_test.zig's newFixture() helper (line 41) generates a brand-new random UUID as `fixture.tenant_id` for every test, and NEVER calls provisionTenantSchema() or inserts a public.tenant row for it -- it is purely a logical/data-column tenant tag layered on top of the tenant_default physical schema that TestHarness.init()/makePool() routes all connections to (matching the convention used by every other passing test in this same file, e.g. TC-EXP-201-01/02, which read/write entity_definitions unqualified via search_path and pass fine). The mismatch is specific to getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance's explicit schema-qualification of entity_type_instances/instance_projections: it assumes tenant_id always maps to a real per-tenant schema, which is true in production (where pool connections' search_path is set from the resolved request tenant per src/db/pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting) but false for this test fixture's usage pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Decide the correct fix: either (a) getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance should route through the connection's own search_path (unqualified table names) rather than deriving+qualifying a schema name from the tenant_id parameter, falling back to explicit qualification only when the connection's tenant context indicates SCHEMA storage mode, or (b) the test fixture should be changed to use a real DEFAULT_TENANT_ID-based tenant consistently and/or provision a real per-tenant schema via provisionTenantSchema() before calling createRecord
Any fix must not regress ISS-0156/GH-475's original fix (both entity_type_instances AND instance_projections rows must still be created together) or ISS-0112's tenant-scope corrective work
TC-EXP-202-01/02/03 pass in isolation (zig build test-integration-exp201-202), twice consecutively
zig build test exits 0 with unit-test pass count >= established baseline (1011/1075, 64 skipped)
next_action: File as GitHub issue and add to global queue. This needs a CODE-DESIGNER pass to decide the correct multi-tenancy contract for entity_type_instances/instance_projections schema resolution -- not a quick fixture patch, since src/entities/commands.zig is production code on the record create/update/delete path used by all entity tests, and the two plausible fixes (route via search_path vs. fix the test fixture) have different blast radii that should be weighed deliberately rather than under time pressure.
resolution:
Decided option (b) from the issue's own acceptance criteria: fixed the test fixture, left src/entities/commands.zig's getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance() and its explicit schema-qualification completely untouched. Rationale, weighed deliberately per the issue's own request not to act under time pressure: getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance's explicit tenant_id -> schema qualification is a DELIBERATE invariant from ISS-0156/GH-475 (which chose this design specifically so entity-type instances get a real, correctly-scoped instance_projections row backing them -- see that issue's 'candidate resolution (a)' and its acceptance criteria, which this fix does not touch). Routing it through ambient search_path instead (option (a)) would have silently written to whatever schema happens to be active at call time rather than the caller's explicitly-declared tenant -- weakening exactly the invariant ISS-0156 established, and risking a production correctness regression (a request whose ambient search_path drifted from its resolved tenant, e.g. under a code path that forgets to call applyRequestStorageRouting, would silently write entity records into the WRONG tenant's schema instead of failing loudly with C42P01 as it does today). This the issue's own acceptance criteria explicitly forbade regressing.

Fixed tests/integration/exp201_202_entities_test.zig's three TC-EXP-202 tests (create/update/delete) to provision fixture.tenant_id's physical schema via the existing, idempotent provisionTenantSchema() (same helper and pattern already used in ISS-0654/GH-663's sim01 fix and ISS-0653/GH-662's event_store TC-ADP-01-02 fix earlier this session), then switch the ambient bpm.api_tenant_context to fixture.tenant_id before pool.acquire() -- this both satisfies getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance's explicit schema requirement AND correctly routes every OTHER unqualified call in the same test (entities.definition.createDefinition/activateDefinition/getDefinitionByName, cleanupEntityType, and the final conn.queryRow verification reads against entity_record_latest, which commands.zig ALSO schema-qualifies -- confirmed via grep) to the same schema, giving each test full per-run schema isolation instead of silently sharing tenant_default with every other concurrently-run test file. TC-EXP-201-01/02 (the two already-passing tests in the same file, which only touch unqualified tables) were left completely untouched -- confirmed still passing.

Verification: zig build test-integration-exp201-202 -- 6/6 pass (TC-EXP-201-01/02 + TC-EXP-202-01/02/03 + one more), 0 leaks, re-run 3 consecutive times. zig build exits 0, no error-set output. lint_sql_param_types.py 0 findings. lint_test_isolation.py OK, 135 files, no baseline drift. zig build test (full unit suite) 89/89 steps, 1011/1075 pass (64 skipped), unchanged from session baseline.
